title: Weird 2nd life dream curious if any similarities.
content: OK I have had a continuing reoccurring dream I've had over the last 17 years. Where I died and woke up at a DMV office in purgatory. Due to budget cuts and escalator being out of order the only way to heaven was a really tall stairway that was hundreds of miles high. So I decided to just go to Hell as a free man, went to school at Hell University and graduated Now I teach there. Occasionally when I do dream back in that world I would either go to the local bar during Unhappy hour and stay until Forgive and Forget hour. Or I would go to a football game at Hell University. Last week's game was between HU Cerberus vs the Purgatory Neflin. Anyone eles have dreams of everyday existence in Helll or continuing their education?
